name: Deep Squat Hold
instructions: Stand with your feet a little wider than your hips and your toes turned out slightly.
Bend your knees and hips and lower yourself as far as you can, with your heels flat on the floor. Keep your knees in line with your toes.
Keep your chest up. You can hold a post or put your elbows inside your knees to stay balanced.
Hold for the set time and breathe slowly. Use your hands on your knees to help you stand up.
